name: What is the difference between different paint finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between different paint finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint finishes range from flat to high-gloss, each with distinct characteristics. Flat finishes offer a non-reflective, velvety look that hides imperfections but is less durable and harder to clean. Eggshell and satin have a slight sheen, are more durable, and easier to clean, making them popular for living areas. Semi-gloss and high-gloss are very durable, reflective, and ideal for trim, doors, and high-moisture areas due to their washability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Paint finishes vary from flat (no shine, hides imperfections) to high-gloss (shiny, very durable, easy to clean), with eggshell and satin in between.
